# jans_plugin (Data Source)

Data source for checking whether a named plugin is deployed on the Janssen server (GET /plugin/{pluginName}).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the plugin to check.

### Read-Only

- `deployed` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is deployed on the server.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
